reasons.title: Manufacturer, not a reseller
reasons.body: We make the valve seal tools and O-ring kits ourselves, so pricing and lead times come straight from the factory rather than through a middleman.

reasons.title: Built for international buyers
reasons.body: We ship worldwide as a matter of course, and quote landed cost and lead time up front rather than after you commit.

reasons.title: A person, on WhatsApp
reasons.body: Send a part number, a photo or a rough description and you get an answer from someone who knows the catalog — not a ticket number.

copy.headline: Valve seal tools and O-ring kits, straight from the factory
copy.tagline: We manufacture automotive repair tools and auto parts and supply them worldwide. Send us a part number or a photo on WhatsApp and we'll come back with the catalog, pricing and lead time.
copy.categoriesLede: Two product lines, manufactured in-house. Diagrams below are illustrative — the catalog carries the full size range.

orderSteps.title: Send us what you need
orderSteps.body: A part number, a photo of the old part, or just the engine and the job. Whatever you have is enough to start.

orderSteps.title: We quote it
orderSteps.body: Pricing, minimum order quantity and lead time, plus shipping to your country — in the same thread, not a follow-up email.

orderSteps.title: We ship it
orderSteps.body: Confirm the order and it goes out. Worldwide shipping, with tracking sent back to you on WhatsApp.
